headline: Novo Nordisk Beats Q3 Profit Forecast and Raises 2026 Guidance
summary: Novo Nordisk reported a third-quarter profit that beat forecasts and raised its full-year 2026 financial guidance.
why: Beating earnings forecasts and upgrading forward guidance signals exceptional demand for core pharmaceutical products, attracting institutional capital.

impacts.name: Novo Nordisk
impacts.why: Higher profit and raised guidance directly increase the fundamental valuation of the stock.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stronger-than-expected quarterly earnings combined with an upward revision to full-year guidance typically drives positive momentum and institutional buying in the stock.
